name: What should I prepare before starting a shower replacement project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a shower replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting your shower replacement project, consider gathering inspiration images, identifying specific needs or frustrations with your current shower, and establishing a general budget. Thinking about your desired aesthetic, preferred features like rainfall showerheads or built-in benches, and any accessibility requirements will help our team design a tailored solution. As your single point of coordination, AKN Design Group will guide you through the detailed planning, ensuring all necessary preparations are covered for a smooth project start.
